domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, approval/rejection, and optional cancellation. Serves as the central aggregate root for the leave management bounded context.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT → SUBMITTED (submit): Employee finalizes and submits the leave request for manager review. Validates balance sufficiency and policy rules.
SUBMITTED → APPROVED (approve): Manager reviews and approves the request. Deducts days from the employee's leave balance. Sets approvedBy and approvedAt.
SUBMITTED → REJECTED (reject): Manager reviews and rejects the request. No balance change occurs. May include a rejection reason.
DRAFT → CANCELLED (cancel): Employee discards a draft request. Terminal state with no side effects.
SUBMITTED → CANCELLED (withdraw): Employee withdraws a submitted but not-yet-reviewed request. No balance change needed.
APPROVED → CANCELLED (cancel_approved): Employee or manager cancels a previously approved leave. Restores the deducted days to the employee's balance.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Each policy governs how many days employees are entitled to, whether accrual applies, minimum notice requirements, and whether manager approval is mandatory. Policies are organization-wide and apply to all eligible employees.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → INACTIVE (deactivate): Policy is disabled by an administrator. No new leave requests can reference this policy, but existing approved requests remain valid.
INACTIVE → ACTIVE (activate): Policy is re-enabled by an administrator.
ACTIVE → ARCHIVED (archive): Policy is permanently retired. Only allowed when no pending or active leave requests reference it.

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization. Each employee has a manager (except top-level), belongs to a department, and holds leave balances. The employee's employment status governs whether they can submit leave requests.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → INACTIVE (deactivate): Employee record is deactivated (e.g., leave of absence). Cannot submit new leave requests but existing ones remain valid.
INACTIVE → ACTIVE (reactivate): Employee record is reactivated. Full leave functionality restored.
ACTIVE → TERMINATED (terminate): Employee is terminated. All pending leave requests are automatically cancelled. Remaining leave balances are frozen.
INACTIVE → TERMINATED (terminate): Employee is terminated while inactive. Same side effects as ACTIVE → TERMINATED.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, usage, and remaining balance for a specific leave policy within a fiscal year. Every employee has one balance per active policy per fiscal year. Balances are the source of truth for leave availability checks.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → ACTIVE (accrue): Periodic accrual adds days to totalEntitlement and remainingDays based on the associated policy's accrualRate.
ACTIVE → ACTIVE (consume): An approved leave request deducts days from remainingDays and increments usedDays.
ACTIVE → ACTIVE (restore): A cancelled approved leave request adds days back to remainingDays and decrements usedDays.
ACTIVE → FROZEN (freeze): Balance is frozen when the employee is terminated. No further accruals or consumption allowed.
ACTIVE → EXPIRED (expire): Balance expires at the end of the fiscal year if the policy does not allow carry-over. Remaining days are zeroed.
ACTIVE → ROLLED_OVER (rollover): At fiscal year end, unused days up to maxAccumulation are carried into the new fiscal year balance.

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Represents a notification sent to an employee or manager in response to leave-related events (submission, approval, rejection, cancellation). Ensures stakeholders are informed of state changes in the leave workflow.
lifecycle_states: PENDING → SENT (send): Notification is dispatched to the recipient via the configured channel.
SENT → READ (read): Recipient has viewed the notification.
SENT → ARCHIVED (archive): Notification is archived without being read.
READ → ARCHIVED (archive): Notification is archived after being read.

business_rules: BR-001 — Leave Balance Sufficiency: Before a LeaveRequest transitions from DRAFT to SUBMITTED, the system must verify that the employee's LeaveBalance for the corresponding policy and fiscal year has sufficient remainingDays to cover the requested leave duration (endDate - startDate + 1, in working days). If remainingDays < requestedDays, the submission must be rejected with an "insufficient balance" error.

BR-002 — Manager Approval Requirement: When a LeavePolicy has requiresManagerApproval = true, a LeaveRequest in SUBMITTED status can only transition to APPROVED by the employee's designated manager (employee.managerId). The system must verify that the approving user's employeeId matches the requesting employee's managerId. Self-approval is prohibited.

BR-003 — Minimum Notice Period: When a LeavePolicy defines minimumNoticeDays > 0, a LeaveRequest can only be submitted if (startDate - today) >= minimumNoticeDays. Emergency leave (leaveType = 'emergency') is exempt from this rule.

BR-004 — Active Employee Only: Only employees with employmentStatus = 'ACTIVE' may create or submit LeaveRequests. If an employee's status transitions to INACTIVE or TERMINATED, all their pending (DRAFT or SUBMITTED) LeaveRequests must be automatically cancelled.
BR-005 — Active Policy Only: A LeaveRequest may only reference a LeavePolicy that is ACTIVE (isActive = true). Requests referencing INACTIVE or ARCHIVED policies must be rejected at submission time.

BR-006 — No Overlapping Approved Leave: An employee cannot have two APPROVED LeaveRequests with overlapping date ranges. The system must check for date-range overlap (existing.startDate <= new.endDate AND existing.endDate >= new.startDate) against all APPROVED requests for the same employee before approving a new request.

BR-007 — Balance Deduction on Approval: When a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, the system must atomically deduct the requested number of days from the employee's LeaveBalance: remainingDays -= requestedDays and usedDays += requestedDays. This must happen within the same transaction as the status change.
